page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Top right: page number 65. Centred block of title lines, then a woodcut ornament, then the date and the signature F. at the foot. No margin notes.

main_text.l: In qua dilucidè confutantur omnia argumenta,
quæ pro asserenda illa D. Bezå, & quidam alij
in medium adduxerunt, vnâ cum multo-
rum sacrae scripturae ad hanc rem
Opus in sex libros digestum: Autore clarif-
simo viro Thoma Erasto, Doctore medico.

page.notes: The ornament is a woodcut fleuron between the title and the date; not transcribed. The word "Beza" carries a small mark after it, rendered here as a superscript flourish. The page number 65 is printed in italic at top right. Some letters in the Erastus line are set in a mix of italic and roman type and may be imperfectly reproduced.
